governedPolicyDenied.title: This action could not be run.
governedPolicyDenied.body: Studio stopped this run under the action safety settings. Check the step wording and ask the CSI owner to review the side-effect setting.
governedPolicyDenied.remedy: For a checkbox or switch, say “check” or “uncheck” explicitly.
governedPolicyDenied.constraints: Do not name hidden reason, claim destructive intent or say secretpasswordrefusal. Existing public POLICY_DENIED is governed; secret-fill narrative only if a distinct landedpublic discriminator proves that branch.

sideEffectConfirmation.title: Confirm this action before it runs.
sideEffectConfirmation.body: Step N says: ‘<authored step text>’. Continue with this action?
sideEffectConfirmation.decline: None of these — I'll edit step N
sideEffectConfirmation.constraints: Single AUTHORED safeLabel rendered verbatim as text; no PAGE role/region on AUTHORED; send only actualchoiceId/generation. Edit action never submits synthetic choiceId; cancel/pending semantics must follow landedcontract. Uses existing clarificationstate, not a new productstate.
